address: 2 Baoye North Street, Haizhu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: After moving along the street to a corner unit, this place now has an updated room equipped with a live fish tank of seafood from the Chaoshan area, such as lobsters and tuatua clams – ask the owner about the catch of the day. Their signature remains Chaoshan-style fish congee featuring various marine fish and dried seafood in a flavoursome pork bone broth. The rice noodles from Tongkeng town are another speciality. The snacks are worth ordering too....
